name: autocache
description: Local session continuity for Codex. Skills and a zero-dependency CLI manage breadcrumbs; native Codex hooks are installed separately by the bundled adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Resume Codex work exactly where it stopped.
interface.longDescription: AutoCache keeps sessions, breadcrumbs, checkpoints, handoffs, reminders, and native-worker receipts in local JSON. Codex keeps its native worker machinery; AutoCache adds the durable continuity envelope around it.
defaultPrompt: Resume the work I was doing before this session.
Open a breadcrumb for this multi-step task.
Checkpoint this work so another session can continue.
